node.title: Jointly charge sparse and high circuits to rank-nine shadows
node.closure: exact circuit-shadow multiplicities and one shared rank-nine mark budget
node.statement: A support-c circuit in a rank-ten eleven-set creates q_c=55-C(11-c,2) rank-nine shadows. If all rank-nine marks have capacity G, high circuits create at least 45 marks, and one record has low-support caps L_c, then complete full-rank incidence is at most floor((G+R*sum_(c=2)^5(45-q_c)L_c)/45). For alternative recordwise low-cap vectors, take the maximum premium before multiplying by R.
